meta.title: Skill Browser
meta.description: One floating ball opens a panel that turns your local skill library into something you can browse, search and govern: one/two-level categories plus custom groups (tree/flat views, manual groups, instant keyword grouping, AI auto-grouping with AI covers — grouping is view-only and never moves skill files), per-skill version badges with a "no version yet" fallback, per-card / per-category / library-wide enable-disable with automatic backups, and a full SKILL.md viewer. A call-ledger dashboard adds date ranges, day/week/month/year granularity, rankings, trend chart and failure details, fed automatically by the host's tools/result event. One-click hot reload, all 128 ball skins contrast-adaptive, configurable skill root, draggable and resettable ball.
